package.name: nxt1_ros
package.description: The nxt1_ros package provides the bindings between the NXT world and the ROS world on the robot. This package will create a ROS topic for each NXT1 sensor, and publish the sensor's data on this topic. The package also creates a topic for each NXT1 motor, which allows you to command the motor from ROS. The nxt1_ros bindings talk directly to the NXT1 brick over USB.
package.author: Rodolphe Matias de Sousa
